title: Doppler Service token (dp.st.): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 6 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: _ glued before dp, boundary: _x glued after the body, so the token is embedded in a longer identifier, and boundary: an identifier byte glued before dp, and 3 more. Twin of "Doppler Service token (dp.st.): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of doppler-token-bare-prose: boundary: an identifier byte glued before dp. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
